description: Two red LEDs in parallel on a 5 V supply, each with its own series resistor: each branch runs VCC -> Rn -> Dn anode, Dn cathode -> GND.
assumptions: Regulated 5 V supply on J_POWER (positive = +5 V, negative = GND), wired by hand.
The kit has no 330 ohm resistor; the user accepted the nearest kit value, 220 ohm (about (5 - 2) V / 220 ohm = 14 mA per red LED instead of 9 mA).
No LED colour was given; the user chose red.
Default _gap_0 variants for the resistors and LEDs (leads in adjacent holes).
